intro: LockBit was the most frequently cited threat actor across 55 ransomware articles published between April and July 2026, alongside The Gentlemen and ShinyHunters. The coverage highlighted critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-1731, CVE-2026-34197, CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073, with 40 high-severity and 6 critical incidents reported. Healthcare, manufacturing, education, and financial services were the primary targets, while affected regions spanned Global, North America, the United States, Europe, and Turkey.
